patches_added.name: Fix notifications on OPPO, OnePlus and realme
patches_added.description: On OPPO, OnePlus and realme phones TikTok can send its notifications through OPPO's push service, which only delivers to TikTok as TikTok signed it, not to a patched copy. This has TikTok use Google's push service on those phones, like it does on other phones. Other phones don't change. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

This has TikTok use Google's push service on those phones, like it does on other phones. Other phones don't change. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: App name
patches_modified.description: Changes the app name shown in the headset's library and in app info. The stock name is just "YouTube", which is easy to confuse with the store app.

patches_modified.name: Default video quality
patches_modified.description: Starts every video at one resolution instead of the app's per-video choice; a resolution the video lacks falls back to its highest available (8K included when the stream spoof provides it). Changeable in the headset's Patch settings; Auto keeps the app's own behaviour.

patches_modified.name: Extension
patches_modified.description: Injects the extension the other patches run through: its streaming spoof is what removes the pre-roll (ad-free playback) and provides the 8K format support. Turning this patch off restores ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Hides video ads, including the pre-roll when the streaming spoof is unavailable and the app falls back to its own player response.

patches_modified.name: Install as clone
patches_modified.description: Installs the patched app as a separate app by default, so it sits alongside the store's YouTube VR instead of replacing it. Replace mode keeps the official package name: the store copy has to be removed to satisfy the signing difference, Horizon OS then treats this build as the YouTube VR app (a restore prompt, and a warning on every reboot), and a store update will collide with it because this build is signed differently.

patches_modified.name: Patch settings
patches_modified.description: Builds the in-headset "Patch settings" hub and the SponsorBlock settings screen. The resource half of the SponsorBlock patch, which mines what this patch restructures the XML with.

patches_modified.name: QUIC (HTTP/3)
patches_modified.description: Adds the in-headset switch for QUIC, the transport under HTTP/3: TLS over UDP, used for this app's API and media requests. Leave it on unless playback stalls on a network that blocks or throttles UDP 443 (corporate Wi-Fi, many VPNs), where turning it off forces TCP/TLS. A change applies after the app restarts.

patches_modified.name: Remove viewer discretion dialog
patches_modified.description: Removes the dialog that appears when opening a video that has been age-restricted by accepting it automatically. This does not bypass the age restriction.

patches_modified.name: SponsorBlock
patches_modified.description: Automatically skips SponsorBlock segments (sponsors, self-promos, intros, ...). On by default (sponsors: skip once); configure per-category behaviour below or in the headset's Patch settings screen.

patches_modified.name: Spoof app version
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to trick the app into thinking you are running a different version; the option ships set to the app's current version, so selecting the patch alone changes nothing.

patches_modified.name: Spoof package name in User-Agent
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to report a different app package name in the Cronet User-Agent; the option ships set to the original package name, so selecting the patch alone changes nothing.

patches_added.name: Custom font
patches_added.description: Replaces Apple Music's font across views, Compose screens, and lyrics using imported .ttf/.otf/.ttc files or system fonts, with optional SF Pro Latin preservation and per-scope settings.

patches_added.name: LRCLIB lyrics
patches_added.description: Fetches lyrics from LRCLIB for songs missing official or synced lyrics, allows per-song LRCLIB overrides and timing offsets, shows an Official / LRCLIB source indicator, and adds LRCLIB settings.

patches_modified.name: Library import, export and downloads
patches_modified.description: Adds JSON library and playlist backups, additive import, and a native download action for the entire library.

patches_modified.name: Liquid Glass bottom bar
patches_modified.description: Adds live refractive glass to Apple Music's mini-player and bottom tabs, an animated selection lens, and a glass transition between the mini-player and Now Playing. Refraction requires Android 13 or newer.

patches_modified.name: Repair Japanese library metadata
patches_modified.description: Finds romanized library metadata and repairs selected songs using Japanese catalog data, preserving library entries and syncing changes to the account.

patches_modified.name: Unlimited Game Review

The phone and Lichess judge moves the Lichess way (?! inaccuracies, ? mistakes, ?? blunders, accuracy and centipawn loss) in chess.com's own review screen, and the phone marks the moves Lichess leaves unmarked Best, Excellent or Good, as chess.com does.
